steps.name: FFP conformance vectors (form-fill provenance)
steps.run:
# Same shape as DYADT: the spec's own vectors are the gate. A detector
# change that stops reproducing a vector's expected line fails here.
# Reference probe only (bash + awk); a product detector runs the same
# runner via FFP_DETECTOR=<command>.
bash 1-formats/sub-specs/form-fill-provenance/spec/conformance/run-conformance.sh

steps.name: Verify this change's own claims (dogfood)
steps.run:
if [ -f CLAIMS.a2ml ]; then
  bash scripts/verify-claims.sh CLAIMS.a2ml
else
  echo "No CLAIMS.a2ml at root — nothing to verify."
fi
